items.reason: The adapalene gel you asked for, to help improve the look of breakouts and uneven texture.
A gentle, active-free cleanser that won't add irritation on top of adapalene.
A light ceramide moisturizer to support comfort and your lower moisture score while the skin adjusts.
Daily mineral SPF 50 is important alongside adapalene, which makes skin more sun-sensitive.

response.routine_note: Use a pea-sized amount of the gel on clean, dry skin at night, starting every other night and building up as your skin tolerates it, then moisturize. Use the cleanser morning and night and the SPF every morning, and skip other exfoliating acids or scrubs while you start.
